import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# Data
income_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': [6, 14, 25, 42, 68],
    'South Asia': [12, 24, 39, 56, 78],
    'Europe': [72, 82, 89, 94, 97],
    'North America': [75, 85, 92, 96, 99]
}

age_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': [38, 32, 26, 18, 11, 5],
    'South Asia': [55, 48, 38, 27, 16, 8],
    'Europe': [98, 96, 93, 88, 79, 58],
    'North America': [99, 97, 95, 91, 84, 65]
}

urban_rural_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': {'Urban': 42, 'Rural': 13},
    'South Asia': {'Urban': 58, 'Rural': 22},
    'Europe': {'Urban': 92, 'Rural': 78},
    'North America': {'Urban': 95, 'Rural': 80}
}

overall_data = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': 27,
    'South Asia': 40,
    'Europe': 89,
    'North America': 93
}

regions = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
quintiles = ['Q1 (Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Highest)']
age_groups = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']

# Color palette - stark, editorial
colors = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#2d3436',
    'South Asia': '#636e72',
    'Europe': '#b2bec3',
    'North America': '#74b9ff'
}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 11))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

# Panel 1: Income Quintile
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
x = np.arange(len(quintiles))
width = 0.2
for i, region in enumerate(regions):
    ax1.bar(x + i * width, income_data[region], width, label=region, color=colors[region], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income Quintile', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('A. Internet Penetration by Income Quintile', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.set_xticks(x + width * 1.5)
ax1.set_xticklabels(quintiles, fontsize=8)
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Panel 2: Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
x = np.arange(len(age_groups))
for i, region in enumerate(regions):
    ax2.plot(x, age_data[region], 'o-', label=region, color=colors[region], linewidth=1.5, markersize=5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('B. Internet Penetration by Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_groups, fontsize=8)
ax2.legend(loc='lower left', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Highlight youth-elder contrast
ax2.annotate('', xy=(0, 99), xytext=(5, 65),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#d63031', lw=1.5))
ax2.annotate('Youth-Elder\nGap', xy=(2.5, 82), fontsize=7, color='#d63031', ha='center')

# Panel 3: Urban-Rural
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
urban = [urban_rural_data[r]['Urban'] for r in regions]
rural = [urban_rural_data[r]['Rural'] for r in regions]
x = np.arange(len(regions))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax3.bar(x - width/2, urban, width, label='Urban', color='#74b9ff', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
bars2 = ax3.bar(x + width/2, rural, width, label='Rural', color='#636e72', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Region', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('C. Urban vs Rural Internet Penetration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels([r.replace(' ', '\n') for r in regions], fontsize=8)
ax3.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.9)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax3.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Gap annotations
for i, region in enumerate(regions):
    gap = urban_rural_data[region]['Urban'] - urban_rural_data[region]['Rural']
    ax3.annotate(f'+{gap}', xy=(i, max(urban[i], rural[i]) + 2), fontsize=7, ha='center', color='#d63031')

# Panel 4: Overall Regional
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
bars = ax4.barh(regions, [overall_data[r] for r in regions], color=[colors[r] for r in regions], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.6)
ax4.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('D. Overall Internet Penetration by Region', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xlim(0, 105)
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax4.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax4.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Add value labels
for bar, region in zip(bars, regions):
    width_val = bar.get_width()
    ax4.text(width_val + 1, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{width_val}%', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Global Internet Penetration Inequality Across Four Dimensions (2023)',
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

# Source note
fig.text(0.5, 0.01, 'Source: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center estimates for 2023',
         ha='center', fontsize=8, style='italic', color='#636e72')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
